articles.title: Is zero an even or odd number? A students’ guide to the logic behind the answer
articles.summary: Mathematicians have formally confirmed that zero is definitively an even number, resolving a common point of contention. According to the precise definition, an even number is any whole number divisible by two with no remainder. Zero perfectly fits this criterion, as 0 divided by 2 results in 0, with a remainder of zero, solidifying its place among even numbers.
